motion._about: Coco companion motion values (design, 2026-10-04): clinging, squeeze, relocation (duck and pop), bubble flips, pointer near, leaving and returning, Reduce motion. Flat keys; "k#" is the comment for "k". Units: pt (points), ms, s, deg, pt/s; scales are ratios (1 = his painted size). Springs use CASpringAnimation units (mass, stiffness, damping; time in seconds). Curves are cubic-bezier control points [x1, y1, x2, y2]. See SPEC.md for the rules that use them.
motion.rig.overscanSidePt#: Transparent margin added left and right of his picture panel, so a lean or squash never clips (needs 15 pt at Large).
motion.rig.overscanTopPt#: Margin above his picture panel (stretch, perk, squeeze growth).
motion.rig.overscanBottomFraction#: Margin below, as a fraction of his height, so a duck or pop in the open is not cut by the panel edge. 0 is fine on the ledge (the window hides it).
motion.rig.filterTransformed#: Picture minification/magnification filter while any rig transform is not identity (nearest gives stair-stepped outlines when skewed).
motion.rig.filterAtRest#: Filter at rest (identity): unchanged from today. Painted sizes only; pixel heads stay nearest always.
motion.rig.bakeFps#: Keyframe rate of a baked continuation for its first rig.bakeTailAfterMs.
motion.rig.bakeTailAfterMs#: After this, keyframes at rig.bakeTailFps (linear interpolation).
motion.rig.bakeTailFps#: Keyframe rate of the tail of a baked continuation.
motion.rig.bakeMaxMs#: A baked continuation never runs longer than this; it ends at rest (identity).
motion.rig.widthPerHeightSquash#: For cling squash and pops: scaleX = 1 + 0.3 * (1 - scaleY) (a chest-like squash, as the breath and the pat).
motion.cling.velocitySmoothingMs#: Exponential smoothing time constant on his anchor velocity (anchor = bottom centre of his rest frame).
motion.cling.leanMass#: Lean spring mass. With the next two: 2.36 Hz, damping ratio 0.283, each half swing 0.40 of the last.
motion.cling.windMaxDeg#: Largest steady trailing lean (the top of his head trails the motion): target = -windMaxDeg * tanh(vx / windRefPtPerS).
motion.cling.windRefPtPerS#: Speed scale of the trailing lean: 1000 pt/s gives 2.1 deg, 2200 gives 3.8, 4000 gives 4.7.
motion.cling.leanSoftLimitDeg#: Shown lean = soft * tanh(lean / soft): never past 7 deg, no hard stop.
motion.cling.squashMass#: Vertical squash spring (his poke spring: 3.63 Hz, damping ratio 0.395).
motion.cling.squashKick#: Squash drive: scaleY acceleration = -squashKick * (d vy_smoothed / dt). Window speeding up upward squashes him, stopping after a lift stretches him (1/s per pt/s).
motion.cling.holdIntervals#: Between events the continuation assumes the window keeps its last velocity for this many mean event intervals, then stops.
motion.cling.settleSpeedPtPerS#: ... and the smoothed anchor speed below this. Then the rig is identity and nothing runs.
motion.cling.faceOnPtPerS#: Hold-on face (the squeeze patch) comes on when the smoothed speed reaches this. A 300 pt move in 0.6 s stays below; a 400 pt move in 0.5 s crosses it.
motion.cling.faceStopPtPerS#: The window counts as stopped below this speed.
motion.cling.faceOpenAfterStopMs#: Eyes open this long after the stop: he holds on through the swing back.
motion.cling.faceMinOnMs#: The hold-on face shows at least this long.
motion.cling.faceBlinkAfterMs#: A relief blink this long after the eyes open.
motion.cling.faceBlinkMs#: That blink is shut this long (the blink patch).
motion.cling.ridesWindowS#: Drags within this many seconds of the previous one count as rides in a row.
motion.cling.ridesSmileFrom#: From this ride on, the smile patch replaces the hold-on face (he starts to enjoy it).
motion.cling.lineMinPeakPtPerS#: The rare ride line: only after a drag whose smoothed speed peaked at least here ...
motion.cling.lineStopFraction#: ... and stopped hard: the speed fell below 0.2 of the peak ...
motion.cling.lineChance#: Then a coin: half the time.
motion.cling.lineCooldownMin#: At most one ride line per 15 minutes. Never while his lines are hidden, asleep, or in an urgent mood.
motion.cling.lineDelayMs#: The line appears this long after the stop (at the swing back).
motion.cling.lineHoldMs#: Shown this long (the reactions line hold).
motion.cling.pixelStepDeg#: Pixel heads (Extra small, Small): no skew; the whole sprite shifts one art pixel per 2.5 deg of lean ...
motion.cling.pixelHysteresisDeg#: ... with 0.4 deg hysteresis between steps. No squash on pixel heads.
motion.cling.ledgeEdgeMarginPt#: On the ledge he stays at least this far in from the window ends (as today).
motion.cling.ledgeScreenMarginPt#: On the ledge he scoots along the edge to stay this far inside the screen while the window goes off an edge.
motion.squeeze.min#: Smallest squeeze on the pressed axis. Pressed further, he keeps this size and is pushed out of sight (behind the window, off the screen edge).
motion.squeeze.volume#: Other axis grows by volume * (1 - squeeze): at 0.78 he is 1.11 on the other axis.
motion.squeeze.faceOn#: Squeeze face (patch) on below this scale.
motion.squeeze.faceOff#: Squeeze face off at or above this scale.
motion.squeeze.besideGapMinPt#: Beside the window: the window edge may come this close (normal gap 10) before it presses on him.
motion.squeeze.screenMarginPt#: He is pressed against the screen edge with this margin.
motion.squeeze.menuBarMarginPt#: On the ledge he is pressed against the bottom of the menu bar with this margin.
motion.squeeze.springMass#: Spring back when the edge lets go (his poke spring): from 0.78 it overshoots to 1.057, from 0.82 to 1.047, settled in about 510 ms.
motion.squeeze.belowSinkFraction#: Below mode (peeking up from the screen bottom): pressed down, he only sinks; past this extra fraction of his height he relocates on release.
motion.relocate.minJumpPt#: A rest frame change without a live gesture (window tiling, keyboard moves, display changes) shorter than this just moves; longer is a duck and pop.
motion.relocate.skipDuckHiddenFraction#: If he is already at least this much out of sight, no duck: straight to the pop.
motion.duck.openMs#: Duck in the open (beside, below, free, corner, manual): duration.
motion.duck.openDepth#: Sinks this fraction of his height.
motion.duck.openFadeFromMs#: Opacity 1 until here, then linear to 0 at the end.
motion.duck.ledgeMs#: Duck on the ledge: sinks right behind the window edge, opaque (the edge hides him).
motion.duck.ledgeDepth#: Ledge duck depth (fraction of his height).
motion.pop.openRiseMs#: Pop in the open: rise duration.
motion.pop.openDepth#: Rises from this fraction of his height below his place.
motion.pop.openStretch#: scaleY 1 + stretch at the start of the rise, relaxing to 1 as he arrives.
motion.pop.openFadeMs#: Opacity 0 to 1 over the first 70 ms (open only).
motion.pop.ledgeRiseMs#: Pop on the ledge: rises from fully behind the window edge, opaque (peek-a-boo).
motion.pop.landMs#: Landing: scaleY down to the land squash over this time (decelerating curve [0, 0, 0.2, 1]) ...
motion.pop.ledgeLandSquash#: ... to this on the ledge, then back to 1 on the squeeze spring. Whole pop settles (|dy| < 0.05 pt, |scaleY - 1| < 0.0015) by 492 ms in the open, 546 ms on the ledge (most of it a sub-point settle; he is up by 130 or 170 ms).
motion.pop.lineAfterMs#: His line (if any) comes back this long after the pop starts, with the flip-in transition.
motion.pop.blinkAfterMs#: A blink this long after any pop starts (an entry blink).
motion.hideHour.waveMs#: "Hide for an hour": the wave frame for this long (swapped on a dip), then the duck.
motion.flip.gapPt#: Gap between his frame and his line (as today).
motion.flip.marginPt#: His line keeps this far inside the visible screen.
motion.flip.hysteresisPt#: Back to a preferred side only when it fits with this much to spare.
motion.flip.outMs#: Flip: the line fades out where it is ...
motion.flip.inMs#: ... then fades in on the new side ...
motion.flip.slidePt#: ... sliding this far out from his side as it fades in (Reduce motion: no slide).
motion.flip.minWidthPt#: Before giving up on every side, wrap the line down to this width and try again.
motion.flip.faceKeepOutPx#: His face, in frame pixels of the 137 x 128 canvas, y down: x0, y0, x1, y1. No line, pill, label or card may cover it. Checked on 12 poses.
motion.flip.faceKeepOutFraction#: The same in fractions of his frame, Cocoa (origin bottom left): minX, minY, maxX, maxY.
motion.near.nearInPt#: His line and task pill: the pointer within this distance of their edge is near ...
motion.near.nearOutPt#: ... and stays near until it is farther than this.
motion.near.downMs#: Fading to a lower opacity: at once, this long ...
motion.near.upDwellMs#: Coming back: only after the pointer has been out of the band this long ...
motion.near.upCurve#: ... with this curve. No dwell when he was approached on purpose.
motion.near.speedTauMs#: Pointer speed over him: exponential smoothing time constant of mouseMoved speeds inside his frame.
motion.near.withSpeedPtPerS#: Inside his frame below this speed: you came to him (deliberate).
motion.near.passSpeedPtPerS#: Above this: passing by. Between: keep the last answer.
motion.near.perk#: Deliberate approach: he perks up, scaleY 1 + perk (scaleX 1 - perk/4) ...
motion.near.perkGraceMs#: After the pointer leaves him, he stays perked this long, then relaxes on the next spring.
motion.near.glanceSideFraction#: If the pointer is more than this fraction of his width left (right) of his centre, he glances that way (glance patch; the right one is requested from B2b).
motion.near.rowAfterMs#: The hover buttons appear after this long of a deliberate approach; a passing pointer never opens them.
motion.near.rowLeaveMs#: They go this long after the pointer leaves him and them (as today).
motion.leave.captureCalmMs#: After a screen capture or share ends, he waits this long (restarted by a new capture) before the pop.
motion.leave.reduceFadeOutMs#: Reduce motion: leaving (when not a cut) is an opacity fade this long (curve [0.4, 0, 1, 1]).
motion.leave.reduceFadeInMs#: Reduce motion: arriving is an opacity fade this long (curve [0, 0, 0.2, 1]).
